name: Redwood National and State Parks
about: Mild and visitable year-round, with summer (Jun–Sep) the driest and clearest stretch and winter bringing more rain but a lush, quiet forest.
overview: Home to the tallest trees on Earth along the foggy Northern California coast.
costOverview: Redwood National Park has no entrance fee at all — the only real cost is a small day-use permit for Fern Canyon, plus normal gateway-town prices for food.
